newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistan money rates plunge on fund inflow.
newsitem.headline: Pakistan money rates plunge on fund inflow.

text.p: Pakistan's money market rates plunged on Monday amid an inflow of funds on maturity of paper sold in an open market operation, and dealers said the presence of excess liquidity was likely to keep the rates low on Tuesday.
The overnight market opened at 11 to 12 percent as the State (central) Bank of Pakistan entered the market for a special open market operation, a dealer at Finex Securities said.
The rates plunged to one percent at close after the central bank picked up only 1.3 billion rupees in the operation against an inflow of 2.8 billion rupees, he said.
The rates are expected to stay within the range of one and two percent on Tuesday, a dealer at Standard Chartered Bank said.
